g.text: The contrast is measurable; the exact edge is not securely located

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203244

g.text: Upper panels: gray spans are excluded line regions; predictions within them are extrapolations of the chosen shape.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203244

g.text: Lower panels: many transition locations fit similarly; some minima reach the allowed boundary. Changing the mask changes the answer.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203244

g.text: Each profile is relative to its own minimum. The dotted Δχ²=3.84 line is a descriptive reference, not a calibrated detection threshold.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203244

g.text: Gaussian instrument model and independent supplied errors. These are mathematical descriptions, not models identifying the power source.
